title: Estimating Willingness to Pay for E85 in the United States Using an Intercept Survey of Flex Motorists
Global Growing Area Elasticities of Key Agricultural Crops Estimated Using Dynamic Heterogeneous Panel Methods
Using the competitive storage model to estimate the impact of ethanol and fueling investment on corn prices
Compliance Path and Impact of Ethanol Mandates on Retail Fuel Market in the Short Run
abstract: Past studies have examined the impact of ethanol mandates with a long‐run perspective and were thus able to assume away short‐run rigidities and some of the specifics of the biofuel mandates. These studies have been of limited use in informing current policy debates because the short‐ to medium‐run reality is one of strong regulatory and infrastructure rigidities that restrict how ethanol can be consumed in the United States. Our objectives in this paper are to provide a more coherent framework than currently exists to model and understand how compliance with ethanol mandates in the short run cannot be met with conventional gasoline blends, how compliance impacts fuel prices and consumer and producer welfare, and also to measure the size of the transfer that occurs between refineries and ethanol producers through the market's Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs). In a model calibrated to 2015 data, we find that the effects of increasing ethanol mandates that are physically feasible are close to zero on the retail price of gasoline. This result is robust to different gasoline prices, supply elasticities, and export‐demand elasticities. Increased mandates can have a large negative effect on the price of high‐level ethanol gasoline blends such as E85 if the mandates are increased to approach consumption capacity.
abstract_zh: 以往研究以长期视角考察乙醇强制掺混政策的影响，因而能够忽略短期刚性以及生物燃料强制要求的具体细节。这些研究对于当前政策辩论的参考价值有限，因为中短期的现实是，监管和基础设施方面的刚性严格限制了乙醇在美国的消费方式。本文的目标是提供一个比现有框架更为连贯的模型，用以理解和刻画以下问题：短期内乙醇强制要求为何无法通过常规汽油混合物满足，遵约如何影响燃料价格以及消费者和生产者福利，并衡量通过市场可再生识别号（RINs）在炼油厂与乙醇生产商之间发生的转移规模。在一个以2015年数据校准的模型中，我们发现，在物理上可行的范围内提高乙醇强制掺混比例，对零售汽油价格的影响接近于零。该结论对不同的汽油价格、供给弹性和出口需求弹性具有稳健性。若将强制掺混比例提高到接近消费能力上限，则可能对E85等高比例乙醇汽油混合燃料的价格产生较大的负面影响。

title: Subfield Profitability Analysis Reveals an Economic Case for Cropland Diversification
abstract: Public agencies and private enterprises increasingly desire to achieve ecosystem service outcomes in agricultural systems, but are limited by perceived conflicts between economic and ecosystem service goals and a lack of tools enabling effective operational management. Here we use Iowa—an agriculturally homogeneous state representative of the Maize Belt—to demonstrate an economic rationale for cropland diversification at the subfield scale. We used a novel computational framework that integrates disparate but publicly available data to map ∼3.3 million unique potential management polygons (9.3 Mha) and reveal subfield opportunities to increase overall field profitability. We analyzed subfield profitability for maize/soybean fields during 2010–2013—four of the most profitable years in recent history—and projected results for 2015. While cropland operating at a loss of US$ 250 ha −1 or more was negligible between 2010 and 2013 at 18 000–190 000 ha (<2% of row-crop land), the extent of highly unprofitable land increased to 2.5 Mha, or 27% of row-crop land, in the 2015 projection. Aggregation of these areas to the township level revealed 'hotspots' for potential management change in Western, Central, and Northeast Iowa. In these least profitable areas, incorporating conservation management that breaks even (e.g., planting low-input perennials), into low-yielding portions of fields could increase overall cropland profitability by 80%. This approach is applicable to the broader region and differs substantially from the status quo of 'top-down' land management for conservation by harnessing private interest to align profitability with the production of ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 公共机构和私营企业日益希望在农业系统中实现生态系统服务成果，但受制于经济目标与生态系统服务目标之间被认为存在的冲突，以及缺乏能够实现有效运营管理的工具。在此，我们以爱荷华州为例（该州农业结构同质，代表玉米带），展示了在次田块尺度上进行耕地多样化的经济依据。我们采用一种新颖的计算框架，整合了分散但公开可得的数据，绘制了约330万个独特的潜在管理多边形（930万公顷），并揭示了通过次田块层面提高整体田块收益的机会。我们分析了2010至2013年玉米/大豆田块的次田块收益情况，这四年是近期历史上最为有利可图的年份之一，并对2015年的结果进行了预测。2010至2013年间，亏损幅度达每公顷250美元或以上的耕地微不足道，仅为18万至19万公顷（不足行作物土地的2%）；而在2015年的预测中，高度亏损土地的面积增至250万公顷，占行作物土地的27%。将这些区域汇总至乡镇层面后，揭示出西部、中部和东北部爱荷华地区存在潜在管理变化的“热点”。在这些收益最低的地区，将保本的保护性管理措施（例如种植低投入多年生植物）纳入低产的田块部分，可使整体耕地收益提高80%。该方法适用于更广泛的区域，并且与当前“自上而下”的保护性土地管理做法有显著不同，它通过利用私人利益，使盈利能力与生态系统服务的生产相一致。

title: Explaining Anomalous Crop Insurance Purchase Decisions Using Prospect Theory
Extensive and Intensive Agricultural Supply Response
abstract: Interest in agricultural supply response increased dramatically after model predictions of land use change were used to estimate biofuel greenhouse gas emissions. The models divide crop response into higher yield—the intensive margin—or more land—the extensive margin. Input adjustments are assumed to drive yield response. But most yield changes result from adoption of technology. Regulators and modelers assume that increased harvested area implies conversion of land from forest or pasture to crops. With the notable exception of African countries, recent expansion of harvested area is due to more intensive use of existing agricultural land through multiple cropping and technology improvement. A lack of response at the extensive margin is consistent with inelastic estimates of land use change estimated by using time-series data. Option value is one reason for this inelastic response. Predictions of land use change based on cross-section data imply much higher land use elasticities than are consistent with recent data.
abstract_zh: 在模型预测的土地利用变化被用于估算生物燃料温室气体排放之后，人们对农业供给响应的兴趣急剧上升。这些模型将作物的反应划分为：通过提高单产来实现的集约边际，或通过增加土地来实现的粗放边际。模型假定投入调整会驱动单产响应。但大多数单产变化来自技术采用。监管者和建模者假定收获面积的增加意味着森林或牧场被转换为作物用地。除非洲国家外，近期农作物收获面积的扩大主要源于通过多季种植和技术进步对现有农用地的更集约利用。粗放边际上缺乏响应，与利用时间序列数据估计的缺乏弹性的土地利用变化估计相一致。期权价值是造成这种缺乏响应的原因之一。基于横截面数据的土地利用变化预测所隐含的土地利用弹性，远高于近期数据所支持的水平。

title: Nitrous Oxide Emission Reductions from Cutting Excessive Nitrogen Fertilizer Applications
Placing Bounds on Extreme Temperature Response of Maize
abstract: Plant water availability is a key factor that determines maize yield response to excess heat. Lack of available data has limited researchers' ability to estimate this relationship at regional and global scales. Using a new soil moisture data set developed by running a crop growth simulator over historical data we demonstrate how current estimates of maize yield sensitivity to high temperature are misleading. We develop an empirical model relating observed yields to climate variables and soil moisture in a high maize production region in the United States to develop bounds on yield sensitivity to high temperatures. For the portion of the region with a relatively long growing season, yield reduction per °C is 10% for high water availability and 32.5% for low water availability. Where the growing season is shorter, yield reduction per °C is 6% for high water availability and 27% for low water availability. These results indicate the importance of using both water availability and temperature to model crop yield response to explain future climate change on crop yields.
abstract_zh: 植物可利用的水分是决定玉米单产对极端高温响应的关键因素。缺乏可用数据限制了研究人员在区域和全球尺度上估计这一关系的能力。利用通过在历史数据上运行作物生长模拟器而开发的新土壤水分数据集，我们表明，目前对玉米单产对高温敏感性的估计存在误导。我们在美国一个高产玉米地区建立了实证模型，将观测单产与气候变量及土壤水分相联系，以确定单产对高温敏感性的边界。在生长季较长的区域，水分充足时每升高1°C单产减少10%，水分匮乏时则减少32.5%。在生长季较短的区域，水分充足时每升高1°C单产减少6%，水分匮乏时减少27%。这些结果表明，在利用温度模型解释未来气候变化对作物单产的影响时，同时考虑水分可利用性和温度的重要性。

title: The Demand for E85: Geographical Location and Retail Capacity Constraints
The Potential for Crop Insurance Reform
abstract:
Purpose
– The purpose of this paper is to discuss the growth and rising costs association with the Federal Crop Insurance program in the USA, justifications for public support, and recent reforms that have been implemented or proposed to reduce program costs. It also analyzes a specific policy to reduce premium assistance spending.
Design/methodology/approach
– Data from the Risk Management Agency are used to illustrate historical trends in crop insurance program costs and to analyze the impacts of imposing a per acre cap on premium assistance.
Findings
– Imposing a per acre cap on premium assistance could achieve significant savings. A $20 per acre cap is estimated to reduce premium subsidy expenditures by more than 40 percent. However, the impact of such a policy would be most severe on crops currently receiving the largest subsidies per acre, which happen to be some of the largest program crops in the USA.
Originality/value
– This paper adds to the literature analyzing potential reform in crop insurance industry. The subsidy cap considered has been proposed and considered by policy makers, and this paper provides estimates for its potential savings.
abstract_zh:
目的
– 本文旨在讨论美国联邦农作物保险计划的增长及其相关的成本上升问题，公共支持的理由，以及为降低计划成本而已实施或提议的近期改革。文章还分析了一项旨在减少保费补贴支出的具体政策。
设计/方法/途径
– 利用风险管理局（Risk Management Agency）的数据，说明农作物保险计划成本的历史趋势，并分析对保费补贴施加每英亩上限的影响。
发现
– 对保费补贴设定每英亩上限可以实现显著节约。据估计，每英亩20美元的上限可使保费补贴支出减少40%以上。然而，这一政策对目前每英亩获得最大补贴的作物影响最为严重，而这些作物恰好是美国一些最大的计划作物。
原创性/价值
– 本文为分析农作物保险行业潜在改革的文献作出了补充。所考虑的补贴上限曾被政策制定者提出并讨论过，本文提供了其潜在节约额的估计。

title: Biofuel Expansion, Fertilizer Use and GHG Emissions: Unintended Consequences of Mitigation Policies
abstract: Increased biofuel production has been associated with direct and indirect land-use change, changes in land management practices, and increased application of fertilizers and pesticides. This has resulted in negative environmental consequences in terms of increased carbon emissions, water quality, pollution, and sediment loads, which may offset the pursued environmental benefits of biofuels. This study analyzes two distinct policies aimed at mitigating the negative environmental impacts of increased agricultural production due to biofuel expansion. The first scenario is a fertilizer tax, which results in an increase in the US nitrogen fertilizer price, and the second is a policy-driven reversion of US cropland into forestland (afforestation). Results show that taxing fertilizer reduces US production of nitrogen-intensive crops, but this is partially offset by higher fertilizer use in other countries responding to higher crop prices. In the afforestation scenario, crop production shifts from high-yielding land in the United States to low-yielding land in the rest of the world. Important policy implications are that domestic policy changes implemented by a large producer like the United States can have fairly significant impacts on the aggregate world commodity markets. Also, the law of unintended consequences results in an inadvertent increase in global greenhouse gas emissions.
abstract_zh: 生物燃料产量的增加与直接和间接的土地利用变化、土地管理方式的改变，以及化肥和农药施用量的增加有关。这导致了负面的环境后果，包括碳排放增加、水质恶化、污染以及泥沙负荷上升，这些后果可能抵消生物燃料所追求的环境效益。本研究分析了两项旨在缓解生物燃料扩张导致农业生产增加所带来负面环境影响的不同政策。第一种情景是化肥税，它会使美国氮肥价格上涨；第二种是政策驱动的将美国耕地恢复为林地（造林）。结果表明，对化肥征税会减少美国氮密集型作物的产量，但这一效应会被其他国家因作物价格上涨而增加化肥使用所部分抵消。在造林情景下，作物生产从美国高产土地转移到世界其他地区的低产土地。重要的政策含义是，像美国这样的大型生产国的国内政策变化，可能对全球农产品市场总体产生相当显著的影响。此外，法律的意外后果导致了全球温室气体排放的无意增加。

title: Ethanol without Subsidies: An Oxymoron or the New Reality?
Modeling Shallow Loss Crop Revenue Programs: Issues and Implications for the 2013 Farm Bill
The Impact of Expansion of Wind Power Capacity and Pricing Methods on the Efficiency of Deregulated Electricity Markets
Are Agrofuels a Conservation Threat or Opportunity for Grassland Birds in the United States?
abstract: In the United States, government-mandated growth in the production of crops dedicated to biofuel (agrofuels) is predicted to increase the demands on existing agricultural lands, potentially threatening the persistence of populations of grassland birds they support. We review recently published literature and datasets to (1) examine the ability of alternative agrofuel crops and their management regimes to provide habitat for grassland birds, (2) determine how crop placement in agricultural landscapes and agrofuel-related land-use change will affect grassland birds, and (3) identify critical research and policy-development needs associated with agrofuel production. We find that native perennial plants proposed as feedstock for agrofuel (switchgrass, Panicum virgatum, and mixed grass—forb prairie) have considerable potential to provide new habitat to a wide range of grassland birds, including rare and threatened species. However, industrialization of agrofuel production that maximizes biomass, homogenizes vegetation structure, and results in the cultivation of small fields within largely forested landscapes is likely to reduce species richness and/or abundance of grassland-dependent birds. Realizing the potential benefits of agrofuel production for grassland birds' conservation will require the development of new policies that encourage agricultural practices specifically targeting the needs of grassland specialists. The broad array of grower-incentive programs in existence may deliver new agrofuel policies effectively but will require coordination at a spatial scale broader than currently practiced, preferably within an adaptive-management framework.
abstract_zh: 在美国，政府强制要求扩大生物燃料（农业燃料，agrofuels）作物的生产，预计将增加对现有农业用地的需求，可能威胁到依赖这些土地生存的草原鸟类种群的延续。我们回顾了近期发表的文献和数据集，以（1）考察替代性农业燃料作物及其管理制度为草原鸟类提供栖息地的能力，（2）确定作物在农业景观中的布局以及与农业燃料相关的土地利用变化将如何影响草原鸟类，以及（3）识别与农业燃料生产相关的关键研究和政策制定需求。我们发现，作为农业燃料原料的本土多年生植物（柳枝稷（switchgrass，Panicum virgatum）和混合禾草—杂类草草原）具有相当大的潜力，可为包括珍稀和受威胁物种在内的多种草原鸟类提供新的栖息地。然而，若农业燃料生产走向产业化，即追求生物质最大化、使植被结构同质化，并将小块田地种植在以森林为主的景观之中，则可能降低草原依赖型鸟类的物种丰富度和/或数量。要实现农业燃料生产对草原鸟类保护的潜在益处，需要制定新的政策，鼓励专门针对草原特有物种需求的农业实践。现有的多种种植者激励计划可能有效地实施新的农业燃料政策，但需要在比目前更广阔的空间尺度上进行协调，并且最好在适应性管理框架内开展。

title: Impact of US Biofuel Policy on US Corn and Gasoline Price Variability
Investment in Cellulosic Biofuel Refineries: Do Waivable Biofuel Mandates Matter?
The Politics and Economics of the U.S. Crop Insurance Program
venue: Chapter in The Intended and Unintended Consequences of U.S. Agricultural and Biotechnology Policy
abstract: The demand for crop insurance is motivated by both expected returns and risk reduction. This chapter presents estimates of demand for crop insurance that isolate the demand for risk reduction from the demand for expected returns by construction of a data set from which the farmer response to actuarially fair contract offers can be estimated. Results indicate that a large number of producers find that the risk reductions offered by revenue insurance generate significant value, suggesting that some public support for crop insurance may be useful if private provision of crop insurance is infeasible because of a lack of reinsurance markets. Results indicate that large premium subsidies are not needed to induce farmers to buy higher amounts of insurance because a significant proportion of farmers would buy actuarially fair insurance. However, significant adverse selection problems would arise if premium subsidies were withdrawn because it is difficult to offer insurance contracts that are individually actuarially fair.
abstract_zh: 作物保险的需求既受预期收益的驱动，也受风险降低的驱动。本章通过构建一个数据集，估计作物保险需求，该数据集可用于估计农户对精算公平（actuarially fair）合同报价的反应，从而将风险降低带来的需求与预期收益带来的需求区分开来。结果表明，大量生产者认为收入保险所提供的风险降低具有显著价值，这提示：若因缺乏再保险市场而导致私人提供作物保险不可行，则某种形式的公共支持可能是有益的。结果还表明，无需大额保费补贴即可诱使农户购买更高保额的保险，因为相当比例的农户愿意购买精算公平的保险。然而，若取消保费补贴，将出现严重的逆向选择问题，因为很难设计出在个体层面上精算公平的保险合同。

title: A Novel Approach for Modeling Deregulated Electricity
Agricultural Land Elasticities in the United States and Brazil
abstract: The elasticity of aggregate supply of cropland is one key to understanding the degree to which policy‐induced increases in demand for biofuel feedstocks or agricultural CO2 offsets will result in higher prices or expanded crop production. We report land supply elasticities for the United States and Brazil estimated directly from recent changes in planted crop acreage and estimated changes in expected returns. The resulting aggregate implied land‐use elasticities with respect to price are quite inelastic in the United States and Brazil elasticities have declined sharply in recent years. The estimated elasticities imply that current estimates of land‐based CO2 emissions from biofuels expansion may be overstated
abstract_zh: 耕地总供给弹性是理解以下问题的关键：政策诱导的生物燃料原料或农业CO2抵消需求的增加，在多大程度上会导致价格上涨，又在多大程度上会带来作物产量的扩张。我们利用近期种植面积的变化及预期收益的估计变化，直接估计了美国和巴西的土地供给弹性。由此得到的总体隐含土地利用价格弹性在美国和巴西均相当缺乏弹性，且巴西的弹性近年来已大幅下降。估计的弹性表明，目前关于生物燃料扩张所引致的土地碳排放的估计可能被高估了。

title: Crop-based Biofuel Production with Acreage Competition and Uncertainty
abstract: This paper examines the role of uncertain crude oil prices, uncertain crop yields, and competition for acreage on corn, soybean, and switchgrass prices under biofuel production mandates. We find enforcement of the cellulosic mandate is costly in that it raises equilibrium prices of all three crops through competition for acreage. However, crude oil prices largely determine industry profitability even in the face of high crop prices. Further we find that uncertainty in crude oil prices and crop yields causes higher corn, soybean, and switchgrass prices compared to a baseline with no uncertainty. (JEL Q21, Q42)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了在生物燃料生产强制性配额下，原油价格不确定性、作物单产不确定性以及土地竞争对玉米、大豆和柳枝稷价格的影响。我们发现，纤维素燃料配额的执行代价高昂，因为它通过土地竞争推高了三种作物的均衡价格。然而，即使在作物价格高企的情况下，原油价格在很大程度上仍决定着行业盈利能力。此外，我们发现，与不存在不确定性的基准情形相比，原油价格和作物单产的不确定性会导致玉米、大豆和柳枝稷的价格更高。（JEL Q21, Q42）

title: Higher U.S. Crop Prices Trigger Little Area Expansion so Marginal Land for Biofuel Crops Is Limited
Opportunity for Profitable Investments in Cellulosic Biofuels
Are U.S. Corn and Soybeans Becoming More Drought Tolerant?
abstract: The hypothesis that corn and soybeans have become more drought tolerant is tested by regressing county yields on a drought index and time. Results indicate that corn yield losses from drought of a given severity, whether measured in quantity terms or as a percentage of mean yields, have decreased over time. Soybean percentage yield losses have also declined, but absolute losses have remained largely constant. The potential impact of increased drought tolerance on U.S. crop insurance rates is illustrated by comparing Group Risk Plan premium rates assuming time‐invariant susceptibility to drought with rates generated from this article's regression results.
abstract_zh: 通过以干旱指数和时间趋势对县级单产进行回归，本文检验了玉米和大豆是否变得更耐旱这一假说。结果表明，在给定干旱严重程度下，玉米因干旱造成的产量损失（无论以数量计还是以占平均单产的百分比计）随时间推移而下降。大豆的百分比产量损失也有所下降，但绝对损失基本保持不变。通过比较两种情形下的团体风险计划（Group Risk Plan）保费费率，本文说明了耐旱性提高对美国作物保险费率的潜在影响：一种假定对干旱的敏感性不随时间变化，另一种则采用本文回归结果所得的费率。

title: An Insurance Approach to Risk Management in the Ethanol Industry
Bottlenecks, Drought, and Oil Price Spikes: Impact on U.S. Ethanol and Agricultural Sectors
abstract: We project U.S. ethanol production and its impact on planted acreage, crop prices, livestock production, trade, and retail food costs. The projections are made using a multicommodity, multicountry, partial equilibrium model. Results indicate that expanded U.S. ethanol production will cause long-run crop prices to increase. In response to higher feed costs, livestock farmgate prices increase enough to cover the feed cost increases. If crude oil prices increase, the U.S. ethanol sector expands. Results of a 1988-type drought scenario combined with a large mandate for ethanol consumption show higher crop prices, a drop in livestock production, and higher food prices.
abstract_zh: 我们预测了美国乙醇产量及其对种植面积、作物价格、畜牧业生产、贸易和零售食品成本的影响。预测采用多商品、多国别的局部均衡模型完成。结果表明，美国乙醇产量的扩张将导致长期作物价格上涨。由于饲料成本上升，畜产品场门价格也随之上涨，且涨幅足以覆盖饲料成本的增加。若原油价格上涨，美国乙醇行业将扩张。1988年型干旱情景与大规模乙醇消费配额相结合的结果显示，作物价格上涨，畜牧业产量下降，食品价格上涨。

abstract: Increased availability and demand for low‐deductible crop insurance policies have increased focus on crop insurance rating methods. Actuarial fairness cannot be achieved if constant multiplicative factors are used to determine how premiums change as coverage levels increase. A comparison of premium rates generated by the factors used by the two most popular crop insurance products with those generated by a standard yield distribution shows that the popular insurance products overcharge for low‐deductible policies in most counties. This overpricing may explain why large premium subsidies were required to induce farmers to move from low‐deductible to high‐deductible policies beginning in 2001.
abstract_zh: 低免赔额作物保险政策的需求增加，并且其供给也日益受到重视，这使得作物保险费率的厘定方法受到更多关注。若采用固定乘数因子来决定保额提高时保费的变化方式，则无法实现精算公平。将美国两款最受欢迎的作物保险产品所用因子生成的保费费率，与基于标准单产分布生成的保费费率进行比较，结果显示，这些热门保险产品在多数县对低免赔额保单存在多收保费的情况。这种定价偏高可能解释了为何自2001年起，要促使农户从低免赔额保单转向高免赔额保单，需要大量保费补贴。

title: Genetic Information in Agricultural Productivity and Product Development
abstract: Two prominent features of recent changes in agriculture have been the advent of precision breeding techniques and an increase in the level of information netputs in production. This article identifies ways in which these features may complement in expanding the variety of processed products, level of productivity, and rate of change in productivity. Using a martingale concept of information, we identify conditions under which information increases the incentives to invest and engage in product differentiation activities. A theory on how genetic uniformity can enhance the rate of learning through process experimentation, and so the rate of technical change, is developed.
abstract_zh: 近期农业变革的两个突出特征是精准育种技术的出现，以及生产投入中信息投入水平的提高。本文识别了这两个特征可能相互促进的途径，它们可能共同扩大加工产品的种类、提高生产率水平并加快生产率的变化速度。利用鞅（martingale）信息概念，我们识别出信息提高投资激励并促使企业开展产品差异化活动的条件。本文还提出了一种理论，说明遗传均一性如何通过工艺试验加快学习速度，从而加快技术进步的速度。

The Efficiency of Sequestering Carbon in Agricultural Soils
abstract: Agricultural tillage practices are important human‐induced activities that can alter carbon emissions from agricultural soils and have the potential to contribute significantly to reductions in greenhouse gas emission (Lal et al., The Potential of U.S. Cropland, 1998). This research investigates the expected costs of sequestering carbon in agricultural soils under different subsidy and market‐based policies. Using detailed National Resources Inventory data, we estimate the probability that farmers adopt conservation tillage practices based on a variety of exogenous characteristics and profit from conventional practices. These estimates are used with physical models of carbon sequestration to estimate the subsidy costs of achieving increased carbon sequestration with alternative subsidy schemes.
abstract_zh: 农业耕作方式是人为活动的重要组成部分，它会改变农业土壤的碳排放，并有可能对温室气体减排作出显著贡献（Lal et al., The Potential of U.S. Cropland, 1998）。本研究考察了在不同补贴和市场化政策下，在农业土壤中固碳的预期成本。利用详细的国家资源调查（National Resources Inventory）数据，我们基于一系列外生特征以及农户从传统耕作中获得的利润，估计了农户采用保护性耕作措施的概率。随后，我们将这些估计与碳固存的物理模型相结合，以估算不同补贴方案下实现更多碳固存的补贴成本。

title: Metamodeling Potential Nitrate Water Pollution in the Central United States
abstract:
This article presents a modeling system for identifying the spatial patterns of potential water pollution from N fertilizer use in the central USA. The model uses a geographic information system (GIS) and a statistical technique to integrate an environmental process simulation model with spatially referenced databases on crop management and resource characteristics. The potential for NO
3
‐N runoff and leaching was estimated for a total of 128 591 sites using information on soil, climate, crop, rotation, tillage, irrigation, and conservation practices at each site. For the entire study region, the average annual NO
3
‐N runoff and leaching, respectively, were estimated to be 5 and 3 kg ha
−1
, which accounted for about 7 and 4% of total N applied. The potential for NO
3
‐N runoff was relatively high in much of the Corn Belt, Kansas, and the Nebraska Platte River Basin, and the potential for NO
3
‐N leaching was relatively high in Ohio, Indiana, and southern Illinois and Missouri. Because much of the area with high leaching potential was tile drained, a large portion of the leached NO
3
‐N will be discharged to surface water, rather than continue downward to ground water. Finally, the model was applied to estimate the effects of a 25% reduction in N application rates and adoption of crop rotations on potential NO
3
‐N runoff and leaching.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个建模系统，用于识别美国中部地区氮肥使用可能造成的水污染的空间格局。该模型利用地理信息系统（GIS）及一种统计技术，将环境过程模拟模型与关于作物管理和资源特征的空间参照数据库整合在一起。我们利用每个地点的土壤、气候、作物、轮作、耕作、灌溉和保护性措施等信息，对共计128,591个地点的NO3-N径流和淋溶潜力进行了估计。在整个研究区域，年均NO3-N径流量和淋溶量分别估计为每公顷5千克和3千克，分别约占施氮总量的7%和4%。NO3-N径流潜力在玉米带的大部分地区、堪萨斯州以及内布拉斯加州普拉特河流域相对较高；NO3-N淋溶潜力在俄亥俄州、印第安纳州、伊利诺伊州南部和密苏里州南部相对较高。由于淋溶潜力较高的区域大部分铺设了暗管排水，因此大量被淋溶的NO3-N将排入地表水，而不是继续向下渗入地下水。最后，我们应用该模型估算了施氮量减少25%以及采用作物轮作对潜在NO3-N径流和淋溶的影响。

abstract: Farmers' management practices can have a significant effect on agricultural pollution. Past research has analyzed factors influencing adoption of a single management practice. But often adoption decisions about many practices are made simultaneously, which suggests use of a polychotomous‐choice model to analyze decisions. Such a model is applied to the choice of alternative management practices on cropland in the Central Nebraska Basin and controlled for self‐selection and the interaction between alternative practices. The results of the choice model are used to estimate the economic and environmental effects of adopting alternative combinations of management practices.
abstract_zh: 农户的管理措施会对农业污染产生重大影响。以往研究大多分析影响单一管理措施采用的因素，但农户往往同时就多项措施作出决策，这提示应使用多元选择（polychotomous-choice）模型来分析这类决策。本文将此类模型应用于中内布拉斯加盆地耕地上替代性管理措施的选择，并控制了自选择以及各项替代措施之间的相互作用。选择模型的结果被用于估计采用不同管理措施组合所带来的经济和环境效应。

title: Targeting Tools for the Purchase of Environmental Amenities
abstract: Use of suboptimal targeting tools to acquire environmental benefits is more the norm than the exception. We analyze how the joint spatial distribution of costs and environmental benefits affect efficiency losses from following targeting rules based on cost or benefits, rather than based on the benefit to cost ratio. Using analytical and numerical models, we demonstrate that the relative variability of costs and benefits and the correlation between the two are primary determinants of efficiency losses. We apply our framework to renewal of Conservation Reserve Program contracts and estimate how well alternative targeting tools obtain environmental benefits under reduced budgets. (JEL Q21)
abstract_zh: 利用次优的瞄准工具来获取环境效益，已是常态而非例外。我们分析了成本与环境效益的联合空间分布如何影响效率损失，比较了基于成本或基于效益的瞄准规则，而非基于效益成本比的规则。利用解析模型和数值模型，我们证明成本与效益的相对变异性及两者之间的相关性是效率损失的主要决定因素。我们将该分析框架应用于保护储备计划（CRP）合同的续签，并估计在预算缩减的情况下，各种替代瞄准工具获取环境效益的效果如何。（JEL Q21）

abstract: An environmental stewardship program, whereby farmers are paid directly for the environmental goods they provide, is developed by combining the microparameter distribution model with mechanism design principles. The program overcomes the information asymmetry between farmers and governments and accounts for the deadweight losses from distortionary taxes. The characteristics of optimal input and payment schedules of the program are derived. These optimal schedules are determined by the tradeoffs between farming profits, environmental benefits, and deadweight losses from taxes, and are second‐best except under restrictive conditions on deadweight losses from taxes and on the marginal product of inputs and marginal pollution costs.
abstract_zh: 本文将微观参数分布模型与机制设计原理相结合，构建了一项环境管理补偿计划，即政府直接为农民所提供的环境产品支付报酬。该计划克服了农民与政府之间的信息不对称，并考虑了扭曲性税收带来的无谓损失。文中推导出该计划最优投入与支付安排的特征。这些最优安排由农业利润、环境效益和税收无谓损失之间的权衡决定，除非在税收无谓损失以及投入的边际产出和边际污染成本的特定限制条件下，它们都是次优的（second-best）。

abstract: A procedure is presented to calculate welfare consequences of chemical regulation from demand curves when input applications are unobserved, and is applied to maleic hydrazide and tobacco. The relationship between chemical residues and weather variables and prices is estimated, and from this we derive demand curves using an application‐residue relationship estimated using research station data. Chemical price levels required to attain given regulatory goals are estimated. Yearly producer losses from a chemical ban range from $@@‐@@6 million to $@@‐@@14 million, two to five times greater than from a tax achieving a 95% assurance rate of residues falling below a proposed standard.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在投入使用量不可观测的情况下，根据需求曲线计算化学品监管福利后果的方法，并将其应用于马来酰肼（maleic hydrazide）与烟草。我们估计了化学残留与天气变量和价格之间的关系，并利用基于试验站数据估计的施用量与残留量关系，推导出需求曲线。文中还估计了达到既定监管目标所需的化学品价格水平。化学品禁用导致的年度生产者损失为 $@@‐@@6 百万至 $@@‐@@14 百万，是以95%的残留低于拟定标准的保证率征收税收所造成损失的两到五倍。

The Value of Weather Information in Market Equilibrium
abstract: Increased accuracy of weather forecasts does not necessarily increase commodity supply or farmer welfare. This study presents a stylized model of competitive production with rational expectations and demonstrates that improved weather information harms farmers facing an inelastic demand. Contrary to the conclusions of previous studies, the decline in farmer welfare does not require an expansion in expected supply. Better weather information may signal farmers to produce less on average under an inelastic demand. A supply decrease occurs when increases in the physical productivity of applied inputs are dominated by adverse price consequences.
abstract_zh: 天气预报准确度的提高未必会增加商品供给或提高农户福利。本研究构建了一个具有理性预期的竞争性生产的程式化模型，并证明：对于面临缺乏弹性需求的农户而言，更准确的天气信息反而会损害其福利。与以往研究的结论不同，农户福利的下降并不要求预期供给的扩张。在缺乏弹性的需求下，更好的天气信息可能使农户平均而言减少产量。当投入要素物理生产率的提高被不利的价格后果所抵消时，供给就会减少。
